title: Tenant-bound API key lookup response
description: API-key and entitlement lookup MUST row-lock the matching key in a serializable transaction before evaluating active, revocation, expiry, or current-scope state. Expiry MUST be evaluated with a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock after the lock and rechecked after response validation immediately before COMMIT; unknown, inactive, concurrently revoked, expired, or invalid-scope keys MUST fail closed without disclosure. Entitlement lookup MUST also row-lock the resolved organization entitlement before response validation.

scopes.description: An active API key response MUST contain a non-empty unique scope list that remains a subset of the provider's current allowlist; empty, malformed, duplicate, or retired scopes MUST fail closed and MUST NOT resolve as an active key.
